column1: # Pokémon Legends: Z-A on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Game Freak's Trinity engine on SDK 19.3.11, update 2.0.2 (the Mega Dimension DLC is seen: "Downloadable content ready"); game.tsv, patches.py and the shader tables are
# upstream's, checked by hand. Every shader is in the Oodle-compressed packs of arc/data.trpfs: the porter decodes them with the game's own decoder on the device
# (dmhost, DM_OODLE_JOB: 223,018 files, about 7 minutes over USB), so a port needs the device connected. 28,603 shaders, all translated.
# Tested 2026-11-04 on the Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16), docked (1920x1080 targets, the game's dynamic resolution at about
# 1056x592): a new save's language, appearance, the name on the host keyboard, the opening cutscene at Prism Tower, the train, the arrival at Lumiose station
# (walking, talking, the camera), Continue from the autosave. 30 fps as on the Switch (the game sets present interval 2 every frame), 0 dropped frames, GPU 12-20 ms
# a frame, sound clean (0 underruns).
# The culling compute shaders' counters grew every frame (GPU 9 -> 70 ms within minutes) until the translator stopped running a single-use atomic twice
# (AstOptimizer: a source with side effects is never propagated).
# Not checked yet: the city streets past the station, battles, catching. Seen once and not reproduced: an NPC passing right beside the camera drew as a black shape
# with blocky white noise for a moment (NPCs held close to the camera afterwards drew correctly); the game fades such characters with alpha-to-coverage dither
# (MultisampleStateGetAlphaToCoverageDither, a2c draws on single-sample targets), the first place to look if it shows again.
# Retroid Pocket 5 (Snapdragon 865, Adreno 650, Android 13, Turnip T30), 2026-11-05, Lumiose City at the Wild Zone 3 gate: docked, the GPU is the limit (46.5 ms
# frames, ~21 fps, with the replay at 12 ms); handheld (env DM_OPMODE=0) holds the game's 30 fps (frame work p50 19-24 ms) once the replay reads cached pool memory
# (gfx_vk_core.c lazy pools, automatic on that device; before them: replay 24 ms, frames 37 ms handheld and 57 ms docked).
# 60 fps: not done. FPSLocker-Warehouse's only Z-A config (1.0.1) is withdrawn; it patches the game's frame-time constants as well (ladders, rolling), so the
# present interval alone is not enough.
